job.title: Junior Cloud Support & Linux Engineer
job.description: HostGlobal Services in Chennai provides 24/7 cloud support and infrastructure management. We are hiring a Fresher/Junior Cloud Support Engineer. You should have strong Linux administration skills, understanding of Apache/Nginx web servers, DNS troubleshooting, and AWS/Azure basics.

Cloud Computing Fundamentals: managed AWS EC2 instances, EBS volumes, and security group rules
AutoSysAdmin: suite of Bash scripts for automated server backups, disk space alerts, and log rotation
B.Sc. Computer Technology, Loyola College, Chennai, 2023–2026
